## Description

/nurse intake queue (cards from "With nurse" column, Open intake) → /nurse/:id/intake: identity check, large inputs for BP systolic/diastolic, pulse, temperature, SpO₂, weight with previous value; out-of-range values flagged in words ("High · re-check", "Outside usual range", "+2.2 kg since …"), prompt to re-measure, then "Escalate to doctor" with reason (creates an urgent item on the doctor's Today). Chief complaint in patient's words.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Values are validated for physiological plausibility (reject impossible values) and flagged against configurable ranges with text, not colour only.
- [ ] **AC2.** A flagged value requires re-measure or an explicit "keep value" before handoff.
- [ ] **AC3.** Escalate to doctor requires a reason and appears on the treating doctor's Today within 2 seconds.
- [ ] **AC4.** Saved vitals become OBSERVATIONs with source "Nurse intake", verified by the nurse, visible in Patient 360.
- [ ] **AC5.** Tablet-first layout with ≥ 44 px targets.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
